project_context.theme: Light Mode (Primary) with Dark Mode Toggle
project_context.archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Refined for Premium Medical Context)
project_context.primary_objective: Modern, clean, and highly trustworthy login/registration screen supporting multi-language (English, Dari, Pashto) with seamless RTL/LTR switching and role-based entry.

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Follow E1's premium typography rule.
typography.instructions: Dynamically switch font-family on the <body> or main container based on the selected language: 'Outfit' for English, 'Vazirmatn' for Dari/Pashto.

primary.name: Medical Teal
primary.usage: Primary CTA buttons, active states, active user-type card borders

secondary.name: Active Emerald
secondary.usage: Success states, 'Open Pharmacy' indicators, verified badges

accent.name: Urgent Coral
accent.usage: Emergency alerts, biomedical service calls, destructive/urgent actions

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Split-screen layout (Bento Grid influence for desktop). Left: Form container. Right: Feature Image.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-8 for cards, gap-6 for forms, py-12 for sections.
layout_and_spacing.rtl_logical_properties: CRITICAL: You MUST use Tailwind's logical properties for margins, paddings, and positioning to natively support RTL without duplicating classes. Use `ms-` (margin-start), `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`, `text-start`, `text-end` instead of left/right specific classes (ml-, mr-, pl-, pr-, text-left, text-right).
layout_and_spacing.surface_style: Premium Medical: Subtle rounded corners (max 12px / rounded-xl). 1px solid borders (border-slate-200/border-slate-700) instead of heavy shadows.

multilingual_rtl_strategy.implementation: Language state should control the HTML `dir` attribute (`dir='ltr'` for EN, `dir='rtl'` for FA/PS).
multilingual_rtl_strategy.switcher: A clean dropdown or toggle in the top-start corner of the screen. Show language native names (English, فارسی, پښتو).

user_type_selector.style: Cards must have an icon, title, and 1px border. When selected, the border turns Primary Medical Teal with a subtle Teal background tint (bg-teal-50 / dark:bg-teal-900/20) and a checkmark icon.

forms.style: Shadcn UI Inputs. Label must be above the input (text-start aligned). Inputs should have rounded-md, ring-primary on focus. Include email and password fields.
forms.social_login: A full-width button for Google Login. White background in light mode with 1px border. Icon: Use react-icons (FcGoogle) or lucide.

buttons.primary: Solid Medical Teal background, white text. Hover state: slightly darker teal. Must have smooth transition.

image_urls.description: Soft minimalist abstract 3d geometry in pale teal and warm sage green. To be used on the right side of the split login screen (hidden on mobile). Overlay with a subtle black/10 or white/10 layer if needed, but it's abstract enough to stand alone.
Authentic diverse healthcare professionals. Alternative image for the right split screen if a human touch is preferred over the abstract background.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter. Import Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Vazirmatn' in index.css.

2. DO NOT use `ml-`, `mr-`, `pl-`, `pr-`, `text-left`, `text-right`. You MUST use Tailwind logical properties: `ms-`, `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`, `text-start`, `text-end`. This guarantees RTL layout works automatically when `<html dir='rtl'>` is set.

3. Implement the split-screen design: Left side max-w-lg container holding the form + headers. Right side: hidden on mobile, block on lg screens, taking up remaining space with `hero_background` image covering the area (object-cover).
4. Build a clean Language Switcher component in the header using shadcn Select or DropdownMenu.
5. Include a Dark Mode toggle (sun/moon icon) using lucide-react next to the Language Switcher.
6. Build the User Type Selection as a visually engaging 2x2 grid of selectable cards before or as part of the registration form.
7. All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language switcher) MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-btn'`).
8. DO NOT hardcode translations, build a simple dictionary object for English, Farsi, and Pashto strings and map them to the UI.
